note: correction learning PRP-fbd7dc4d: Accepted: the revision asks for purpose text that names data sources and what does not change, which is exactly what the Product Analyst had to add by hand on US-3. Default set changed; re-record before the next replay. — The corrections indicated a need for more detail in purpose descriptions, particularly regarding data handling and source clarity. The user story also shifted to reflect prioritization and accuracy in dependency handling. Changes focus on explicit details needed in purpose, ensuring stories are sufficiently detailed and correctly ordered.
